title: FLUX.2 Klein 9B edit, guided by a depth picture
description: Like "FLUX.2 Klein 9B edit, up to five pictures" (flux2-klein-9b-da-edit), but image 1 reaches the model as its depth picture (Depth Anything V2 Small, the Depth pack this template offers to install): the layout and pose of image 1 are kept, and the colours come from the other references and the prompt. Bypass the Depth Estimate node to use image 1 itself. Use the plain edit template when you do not need depth.
